import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/openssl/fuzz/client.c","function":"FuzzerTestOneInput","line":34,"var":"buf,len","code":"if (len == 0) return 0;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes enter the client fuzzer as the raw input buffer and length."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/openssl/fuzz/client.c","function":"FuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"ctx","code":"ctx = SSL_CTX_new(SSLv23_method());","note":"A TLS client context is created to parse and process the supplied handshake bytes."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/openssl/fuzz/client.c","function":"FuzzerTestOneInput","line":45,"var":"client","code":"client = SSL_new(ctx);","note":"The SSL object is allocated and will consume the attacker-controlled BIO stream."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/openssl/fuzz/client.c","function":"FuzzerTestOneInput","line":49,"var":"in","code":"OPENSSL_assert((size_t)BIO_write(in, buf, len) == len);","note":"The entire input is copied into the memory BIO, making it the handshake transcript seen by OpenSSL."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/openssl/fuzz/client.c","function":"FuzzerTestOneInput","line":50,"var":"SSL_do_handshake(client)","code":"if (SSL_do_handshake(client) == 1) {","note":"OpenSSL parses the attacker-controlled handshake and may reach certificate/key handling paths."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/openssl/fuzz/client.c","function":"FuzzerTestOneInput","line":53,"var":"SSL_read(client, tmp, sizeof(tmp))","code":"for (;;) { if (SSL_read(client, tmp, sizeof(tmp)) <= 0) break; }","note":"After handshake completion, application-data processing continues on the same attacker-controlled connection state."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/openssl/ssl/ssl_lib.c","function":"SSL_free","line":0,"var":"ssl->cert / pkeys","code":"SSL_free(client);","note":"Cleanup releases SSL-owned certificate/key structures; the vulnerable path in the target can double-free or use freed DH/EVP_PKEY state during teardown, matching the reported CRYPTO_DOWN_REF -> DH_free -> evp_pkey_free_it crash state."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
